U.note: Clean working collapsible bento with roast, grind and count controls, but visually modest and the folded state is a lone pill.

V.note: Polished pill bar and a varied bento with accordions, a subscription radiogroup and cafe hours, all wired with status announcements and keyboard support.

W.note: The bento itself collapses and expands with FLIP animation into a rich tile grid, and the tiles stay usable when folded, which is the most faithful take on a collapsible bento menu.

X.note: Feature-rich bento with a roast slider, subscription, accordions, night theme and toasts, though it reads more like a settings dashboard than a navigation menu.

Y.note: A true navigation bento dropdown with arrow-key focus and a cart stepper, but the overlay covers the page text and the panel feels small and plain.

Z.note: Distinctive dark tin-pile concept where tiles fly out of the handle into a grid, with good focus handling, though the overlay covers the hero and the rest state is heavy.
